sources: https://lewis-and-clark-fairgrounds.checkfront.com/reserve/ (the 'Book Campsite' link; 'Account Not Found', read in a browser)

values.note: Pads are 60 x 15, 45 x 15 and 30 x 15 ft.

sites.source: https://lccfairgrounds.com/facility-rentals ('We have 22 camping spaces available.') + https://lccfairgrounds.com/campsites ('60 x 15 PAD SIZE', '45 x 15 PAD SIZE', '30 x 15 PAD SIZE'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Every campsite includes electricity; the fairgrounds do not state the amperage (the 30/50-amp figure came only from camper reviews). No water at the sites.

hookups.source: https://lccfairgrounds.com/facility-rentals ('Campsites are $35.00 per night and include electricity.'; 'There are water fill-up stations in our main parking lot, but not in the campground area.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water fill-up stations in the main parking lot, not in the campground. No RV dump. The fairgrounds' pages do not mention a shower house (camper reviews only).

facilities.source: https://lccfairgrounds.com/facility-rentals ('There are water fill-up stations in our main parking lot, but not in the campground area.', 'There is NO RV dump.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Maximum 7 days in any 30-day period; no refunds. Arrivals without a reservation check in at the office (west side of the Exhibit Building, 8am-5pm Mon-Fri) for availability, or call the number on the office door after hours. The page's 'Book Campsite' link goes to a Checkfront account that no longer exists, so book by phone (406-457-8516).

booking.source: https://lccfairgrounds.com/facility-rentals ('We do have a maximum stay of 7 days in a 30 day period'; 'If you arrive at the Fairgrounds without a reservation, please check in at the office ... for availability and payment.'; 'Book Campsite') + https://lewis-and-clark-fairgrounds.checkfront.com/reserve/ ('Account Not Found'), read 2026-10-22

note: Lewis & Clark County Fairgrounds campground in Helena, open to campers outside fair events. --Claude
summary: Fairgrounds' own page: confirmed 7-night limit (in any 30 days), water fill in the parking lot, no dump, phone 406-457-8516; added 22 spaces, reservable with walk-ups at the office. Cleared derived 50-amp and showers (camper reviews only; page says electricity included, no amperage, no shower house mentioned). Page gives $35/night including electricity but undated, so fees not written. Note trimmed of the wrong ~$22 price and restated values.
flags: Rate: the fairgrounds' page says 'Campsites are $35.00 per night and include electricity' with no date (the old note's ~$22 is out of date); not written because the rate carries no 2024+ date.

Broken booking link: the campsites page's 'Book Campsite' widget points to lewis-and-clark-fairgrounds.checkfront.com, which returns 'Account Not Found'; the availability boxes on https://lccfairgrounds.com/campsites sit at 'Searching Availability...'. Reservations appear to be phone/office only for now.
